quote.author: KeithSmithNBA
quote.text:
Rookie giveth, rookie taketh away.

Mikel Brown Jr. got the Nets to overtime with some huge shots, including a buzzer-beating three.

In overtime, he's missed a couple of open jumpers and just missed an open layup.

items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
Mikel Brown Jr. can't convert on the layup. Jordan Walsh grabs the rebound. The Celtics will get one last chance.

Boston trails 124-123, with 2.3 seconds left in OT. We'll see what Joe Mazzulla dials up.
